boundaries as generated proof-free value objects, with each occurrence's
selected constructor and nested `Fin` or `Subtype` checks. A host callback that

boundary validates the recovery before the callback runs, checks the actual
reply, and never returns the recovery as successful output. A returned

rejection. The [hosted promotion](evidence/callback-refinements-php-wasm-promotion-20261023.md)

synchronous copied-value callbacks; retained, asynchronous, open-dependent and
recursive refined callbacks remain outside the profile.
